library(pacman)
## Warning: package 'pacman' was built under R version 4.5.3
p_load(SDMtune,
       tidyverse, 
       terra, 
       sf, 
       ENMeval,
       ggplot2,
       tidyterra,
       gt
)

Set seed for reproducibility

set.seed(15) #set random seed in order to reproduce this analysis

Read in presence and environmental data

occ_train <- read.csv("ENM_sensitivity_analysis_inputs/gh_occs_train_69_24.csv")
occ_test <- read.csv("../../ENM_inputs_final/gh_occs_test_05_24.csv")


envs <- rast("ENM_sensitivity_analysis_inputs/gh_envs_69_24.tif")

bg <- read.csv("ENM_sensitivity_analysis_inputs/gh_bg_69_24.csv")

bg <- bg %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X)

names(envs)
## [1] "mean_temp_coldest_quarter" "precip_wettest_quarter"   
## [3] "NDVI_mean"                 "elevation"                
## [5] "built_surface"             "edge_density"
# Create SWD object
train_data <- prepareSWD(species = "Yellow Fever",
                   p = occ_train,
                   a = bg,
                   env = envs)
## ℹ Extracting predictor information for presence locations✔ Extracting predictor information for presence locations [344ms]
## ℹ Extracting predictor information for absence/background locations✔ Extracting predictor information for absence/background locations [914ms]
test_data <- prepareSWD(species = "Yellow Fever",
                   p = occ_test,
                   a = bg,
                   env = envs)
## ℹ Extracting predictor information for presence locations✔ Extracting predictor information for presence locations [215ms]
## ℹ Extracting predictor information for absence/background locations✔ Extracting predictor information for absence/background locations [257ms]

cb_folds <- get.checkerboard(occ_train, envs, bg, aggregation.factor = c(8,8))
## Generating hierarchical checkerboard partitions...
table(cb_folds$occs.grp)
## 
##  1  2  3  4 
## 29 26 31 27
table(cb_folds$bg.grp)
## 
##    1    2    3    4 
## 2486 2469 2499 2546
# Train a Maxnet model
model <- train(method = "Maxnet", 
               data = train_data, 
               folds = cb_folds,
               reg =  0.5,
               fc = "l")
## Cross Validation  ■■■■■■■■■                         25% | ETA:  7s - 00:00:2.2Cross Validation  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■                  50% | ETA:  3s - 00:00:3.3Cross Validation  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■           75% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:4.4Cross Validation  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■  100% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:5.6
model
## 
## ── Object of class: <SDMmodelCV> ──
## 
## Method: Maxnet
## 
## ── Hyperparameters 
## • fc: "l"
## • reg: 0.5
## 
## ── Info 
## • Species: Yellow Fever
## • Replicates: 4
## • Total presence locations: 113
## • Total absence locations: 10000
## 
## ── Variables 
## • Continuous: "mean_temp_coldest_quarter", "precip_wettest_quarter",
## "NDVI_mean", "elevation", "built_surface", and "edge_density"
## • Categorical: NA
vi_maxnet <- SDMtune::varImp(model, 
                    permut = 5)
## Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■           75% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:2…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■        83% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:2…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■       88% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:2…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■     92% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:3…Variable importance  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■  100% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:3…
vi_maxnet <- vi_maxnet %>% 
  mutate(Variable = case_when(
    Variable == "built_surface" ~ "Built surface area",
    Variable == "edge_density" ~ "Edge density",
    Variable == "mean_temp_coldest_quarter" ~ "Mean temperature of coldest quarter",
    Variable == "precip_wettest_quarter" ~ "Precipitation of wettest quarter",
    Variable == "NDVI_mean" ~ "NDVI",
    Variable == "elevation" ~ "Elevation",
  ))

vi_maxnet_tbl <- vi_maxnet %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  cols_label(
    Variable = "Covariate",
    Permutation_importance = "Permutation importance (%)",
    sd = "Standard deviation (%)"
  ) %>% 
  fmt_number(
    columns = c("Permutation_importance", "sd"),
    decimals = 2
  )

vi_maxnet_tbl

tiff("Final_Results/variable_importance_SA.tif", width = 180, height = 120, units = "mm", res = 300, compression = "lzw")

plotVarImp(vi_maxnet)

dev.off()
## png 
##   2
plotVarImp(vi_maxnet)

sd_map <- predict(model,
        data = envs,
        fun = "sd",
        type = "cloglog")
## Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■                           20% | ETA:  8s - 00:00:02Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■                     40% | ETA:  5s - 00:00:3.1Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■               60% | ETA:  3s - 00:00:4.1Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■         80% | ETA:  1s - 00:00:4.9Predict - Maxnet  ■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■  100% | ETA:  0s - 00:00:7.3
summary(sd_map)
## Warning: [summary] used a sample
##        sd       
##  Min.   :0.000  
##  1st Qu.:0.016  
##  Median :0.026  
##  Mean   :0.033  
##  3rd Qu.:0.040  
##  Max.   :0.282  
##  NA's   :32723
plot(sd_map)

#min 0.0000000
#max 0.307
sd_map_final <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatraster(data = sd_map) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(, option = "mako", na.value = "transparent") +
  labs(fill = "Environmental Suitability\nStandard Deviation")+
  theme_bw() + #Clean theme
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # Remove major grid lines
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),  # Remove minor grid lines
    axis.ticks = element_blank(), # Remove axis ticks,
    axis.text = element_blank(),  # Remove axis text (coordinate degrees)
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank()
  )

sd_map_final

ggsave(
filename = file.path("Final_Results/GH_SA_SD_suitability_map.tiff"),
plot = sd_map_final,
device = "tiff",
dpi = 300,
width = 180,
height = 120,
units = "mm",
compression = "lzw"
)
